name: H-486 Cobra

origin.basis: Chaoyang is the bicycle-tire brand of ZC Rubber (Zhongce).

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Low-cost folding road tire with a slick tread, the predecessor of the H-496 Falcon.
weight_basis: No weight is given in the listing.

community.summary: A commenter found it puncture-resistant but slow-rolling.

availability.note: Sold by many mainland Taobao shops; no official-store listing for this model was found on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.conditions: Taobao/Tmall shop list price on 2026-11-01; shipping within mainland China. The listing does not say whether an option is one tire or a pair. Shown as a 'from' price for the 23-28C options.

caveats: Specifications are not published in the listing; treat it as a budget training tire.

image.shown: H-486 Cobra tires in their retail boxes, labelled H-486, COBRA and 700x23C, in an owner's post; the 25C and 28C versions are not shown.
image.alt: Chaoyang H-486 Cobra road tires in labelled 700x23C retail boxes

rights.usage_note: A photo from a public Xiaohongshu post, shown from Xiaohongshu with a link to the original post; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model; questions, seller and maker replies, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out. An unmounted first impression and a mounting video are not counted.

reports.summary: Very good in use; of two tires, one was still going at 2,000 km and the other's sidewall failed after 100 km.
The sidewalls are very thin and ruined three inner tubes.
Both tires cracked all the way around after under 600 km and a winter in storage.
A tire bought in March 2024 had cracked by September and was scrapped.

checks.note: Three posts; a claimed maker reply is not counted
